Hero.subhead: When local isn't enough, call your friends. A collective of freelance riggers, arriving in your venue knowing the motors, the bridles, and the shortcut backstage.

About.p1: We're a Czech collective of freelance riggers working across Europe — ground, up, head. Hundreds of shows, dozens of arenas, over a decade each.
About.p2: When your crew's booked on two shows the same weekend, or when the tour rolling into your venue needs more hands than you've got, that's where we come in. One rigger. Six. Whatever the call sheet says.
About.p3: IRATA, IPAF, A1 forms, full liability and workers' comp across the EU. All of us, all current.
About.p4: No agency margin, no middle layer. You hire freelancers directly, which is why we can keep the certifications current, the gear dialed, and the crew we run with the kind you'd actually want on rope next to you.
About.p5: Book us as your local riggers. Wherever in Europe that happens to be.

Crew.heading: The people hanging the show.
Crew.p1: One crew, known to each other — not a roster of strangers booked last minute.
Crew.p2: We met on tours across Europe over the years. Different cities, different shows, the same handful of people kept ending up at the top of the truss together. You don't keep picking the same partners on rope unless they know what they're doing — and unless you trust them with your day.
Crew.p3: The friendship came after. The reason we work together is that everyone here is good at this, and safe at it. That part comes first.
Crew.p4: When you book one of us, you book a crew that already knows how the others move.

jarda.longBio: Six years in technical production — festivals, concerts, sports events — before deciding he'd rather be up on a truss than behind a laptop at 2 a.m. Now doesn't sleep either way.
jarda.projects: Technical production and 3D modeling for the inaugural Laver Cup at O2 Arena Prague, Eurovision Song Contest 2025, plus a steady residency across Swiss and German venues.

items.q: Do you travel with your own gear?
items.a: Yes — personal harnesses, helmets, tools, PPE. For large gear (motors, bridles), we assume the venue / host company provides.
We're usually on the road, but we try to keep our calendar public. Use the booking calendar below to mark the dates you'd need us and we'll reply as fast as we can — usually the same day.
All of us carry health insurance, liability insurance (coverage in millions), and professional work insurance. Paperwork available on request.
All of us operate as licensed businesses in the Czech Republic (živnostenský list).
All Czech Republic nationals, all EU-based, all holding valid A1 forms for cross-border work.
By car, plane, or boat — whichever gets us there on time.
English across the board. German — learning in progress (some of us faster than others).
Czech Republic is home. Some of us are based abroad (Switzerland, Germany) depending on current tours.
